requirements.title: ATAN2D result value is a degree-valued atan2 result in the stated range
requirements.definition: The ATAN2D result is expressed in degrees, lies in the range -180 through 180, and approximates ATAN2(Y,X) multiplied by 180/pi.

pending.atan2d-degree-result-range: Left pending by intrinsics_16_9_d review follow-up: the only exact property stated here is the broad [-180, 180] degree range, which does not distinguish an ATAN2 radian substitution because ATAN2's radian principal values also lie inside that interval; the degree approximation has no portable error bound.
